name: upgrade_replay
description: NOTE: an actual contract-upgrade step (uploading new WASM via env.deployer().upload_contract_wasm()) is out of scope for this native, no-WASM-build harness and isn't in the SimStep schema. This scenario instead verifies the replay property that matters most for upgrade confidence: running it twice against fresh instances (see test_upgrade_replay_produces_identical_final_state) must produce byte-identical proposal states, vote tallies, and final ledger — i.e. nothing here depends on wall-clock time or uncontrolled randomness. Run `nebgov-sim run` on this scenario before and after a contract change and diff the two reports with scripts/simulate.ts's compareReports() as a coarse backward-compatibility smoke test.
